model.name: gemma-4-31b (agent)
model.about: Google Gemma 4, 31B dense, BF16 as released. Apache-2.0. Matched to the October gemma-4-26b retest: vLLM 0.31.0, Gemma tool/reasoning parsers and tool chat template, explicit non-thinking requests, no free JSON whitespace. Run --quick before a full benchmark; the Gemma 4 family previously exhibited repetition under strict JSON.

answers.sql:
SELECT 
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel, 
    COUNT(f.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE
  IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, 
    COUNT(f.ALRT_ID) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE f.DTCTN_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND f.DTCTN_AT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  count(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day_aug AS (
    SELECT MAX(dt_k) as max_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE cal_yr_nbr = 2025 AND mth_nbr = 8
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.bus_id) as default_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN last_day_aug lda ON f.bus_dt_k = lda.max_dt_k
WHERE f.dflt_flg = TRUE;

SELECT 
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, 
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND cat.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    f.QUOT_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS average_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.QUOT_CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name, 
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_valuation DESC;

SELECT 
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT <= '2025-12-31'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT 
    br.CTY_NM, 
    COUNT(*) as txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  AVG(f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT 
    AVG(f.MID_RT) as avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH current_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
customers_with_txns_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE f.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
)
SELECT COUNT(curr.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM current_customers curr
LEFT JOIN customers_with_txns_2025 txns ON curr.BUS_ID = txns.BUS_ID
WHERE txns.BUS_ID IS NULL;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE ATHRZ_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND ATHRZ_AT < '2026-01-01';

SELECT 
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS category_name, 
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE 
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND cat.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT 
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, 
    SUM(t.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, 
    COUNT(f.ALRT_ID) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.DTCTN_AT) = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
  count(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  AND c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT 
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name, 
    SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
  AND p.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
  count(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE
  c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND f.INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND f.INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH BranchTxnCount AS (
    SELECT 
        b.RGN_CD1, 
        b.DSPLY_NM, 
        COUNT(*) as txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT 
    RGN_CD1, 
    DSPLY_NM, 
    txn_count
FROM BranchTxnCount
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT 
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount 
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.ATHRZ_AT) = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    c.BUS_ID, 
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) as total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
both_customers AS (
    SELECT wc.CUST_K
    FROM wire_customers wc
    JOIN atm_customers ac ON wc.CUST_K = ac.CUST_K
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) as distinct_customer_count
FROM both_customers bc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON bc.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT count(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01'

SELECT 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, 
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = TRUE) AS weekend_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = FALSE) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH balances AS (
    SELECT 
        f.ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' THEN f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT END) as bal_june,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31' THEN f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT END) as bal_dec
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN ('2025-06-30', '2025-12-31')
    GROUP BY f.ACCT_K
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) 
FROM balances 
WHERE bal_june IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec < (bal_june * 0.9)

SELECT 
    cat.dsply_nm, 
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (f.rsltn_at - f.cntct_strtd_at))) as avg_days
FROM bank_dwh.f_cmplt f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cmplt_ctg cat ON f.cmplt_ctg_k = cat.cmplt_ctg_k
WHERE f.is_rslvd = TRUE 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.cntct_strtd_at) = 2025
  AND cat.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.dsply_nm;

WITH customer_versions AS (
  SELECT 
    BUS_ID, 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
    VRSN_NBR, 
    IS_CURR,
    LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR ASC) as prev_segment
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM customer_versions 
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE 
  AND prev_segment IS NOT NULL 
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev_segment;

WITH cust_quarters AS (
    SELECT 
        c.BUS_ID,
        d.QTR_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY c.BUS_ID, d.QTR_NBR
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT BUS_ID
    FROM cust_quarters
    GROUP BY BUS_ID
    HAVING COUNT(QTR_NBR) = 4
) AS loyal_customers;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON d.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.BUS_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT c2.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2 ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt2.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c2 ON w.CUST_K = c2.CUST_K
    WHERE dt2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )

SELECT
    count(DISTINCT f2024.LN_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f2024
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2024 ON f2024.BUS_DT_K = d2024.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f2025 ON f2024.LN_ID = f2025.LN_ID
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2025 ON f2025.BUS_DT_K = d2025.DT_K
WHERE d2024.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
  AND f2024.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND d2025.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  AND f2025.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.CAL_YR_NBR, 
        COUNT(*) as txns
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
    WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txns END) as txns_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txns END) as txns_2025
    FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT 
    ((txns_2025 - txns_2024) * 100.0 / txns_2024) as growth_percentage
FROM pivot;

WITH monthly_last_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        d.MTH_NBR, 
        MAX(d.DT_K) as last_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT 
    mld.MTH_NBR, 
    SUM(f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT) as total_closing_balance
FROM monthly_last_dates mld
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON mld.last_dt_k = f.BUS_DT_K
GROUP BY mld.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY mld.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE
    c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= '2025-01-01'
    AND c.CUST_SNC_DT <= '2025-12-31'
    AND t.PSTD_AT >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND t.PSTD_AT <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59';

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' >= EFF_FRM_DT 
  AND ('2023-06-30' < EFF_TO_DT OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        C.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        C.BUS_ID, 
        SUM(F.STLM_AMT) as total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF F
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST C ON F.CUST_K = C.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
    WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND C.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY C.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, C.BUS_ID
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        BUS_ID, 
        total_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rank
    FROM CustomerTotals
)
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
    BUS_ID, 
    total_amount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1, total_amount DESC;

WITH total_2025 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
ccy_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CCY_CD1 as currency_code, 
        COUNT(*) as ccy_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY CCY_CD1
)
SELECT 
    currency_code,
    (ccy_count * 100.0 / total_count) as percentage
FROM ccy_counts, total_2025
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.MTH_NBR, 
        COUNT(*) as monthly_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT 
    MTH_NBR, 
    monthly_count, 
    SUM(monthly_count) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) as running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT 
            ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT 
        END
    ) as total_eur_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON t.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K 
    AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' 
    AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ATHRZ_AT) AS month_number, 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS decline_share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ATHRZ_AT) = 2025
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    c.DSPLY_NM as channel, 
    count(*) as txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT count(DISTINCT BUS_ID) 
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST 
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE 
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM as jurisdiction, 
    COUNT(f.ALRT_ID) as alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.DTCTN_AT) = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC

SELECT 
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, 
    COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  count(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH month_end AS (
    SELECT MAX(DT_K) as end_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND MTH_NBR = 8
      AND IS_MTH_END = TRUE
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
CROSS JOIN month_end
WHERE f.BUS_DT_K = month_end.end_dt_k
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT 
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, 
    COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND cat.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, 
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS average_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    m.DSPLY_NM as market_name, 
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) as total_market_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_valuation DESC;

SELECT 
    ACCT_TYP_CD1, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) as account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT <= '2025-12-31'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT 
    br.CTY_NM AS city, 
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT 
    AVG(f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT) AS average_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR, 
    COUNT(*) as dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH active_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
LEFT JOIN active_customers_2025 a ON c.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND a.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM INTTD_AT) = 2025;

SELECT 
    cat.DSPLY_NM as category_name, 
    count(*) as complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND cat.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT 
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, 
    SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT 
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' 
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM, 
    COUNT(f.ALRT_ID) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.DTCTN_AT) = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT count(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH mobile_channel AS (
    SELECT CHNL_K 
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CHNL 
    WHERE DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App' 
      AND IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, 
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN mobile_channel mc ON f.CHNL_K = mc.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT 
    p.DSPLY_NM as product_name, 
    SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) as total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
  AND p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT
  count(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true;

WITH branch_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.RGN_CD1, 
        b.DSPLY_NM, 
        COUNT(*) as txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND b.IS_CURR = true
    GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT 
    RGN_CD1, 
    DSPLY_NM, 
    txn_count
FROM branch_counts
WHERE rank = 1;

SELECT 
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) as total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
WHERE f.ATHRZ_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND f.ATHRZ_AT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    C.BUS_ID, 
    SUM(F.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF F
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST C ON F.CUST_K = C.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND C.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY C.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  ON c.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_w
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d_w.DT_K
WHERE
  d_w.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.BUS_ID IN (
    SELECT
      c2.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c2
    JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
      ON c2.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_a
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d_a.DT_K
    WHERE
      d_a.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )

SELECT
  count(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE
  INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01';

SELECT 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, 
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH LatestDate AS (
    SELECT MAX(BUS_DT_K) as max_dt FROM bank_dwh.F_CR_RSK_EXPO_D
)
SELECT 
    c.BUS_ID as customer_id,
    c.LGL_NM as customer_name,
    f.SCR_VAL1 as churn_risk_score
FROM bank_dwh.F_CR_RSK_EXPO_D f
JOIN LatestDate ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.max_dt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY f.SCR_VAL1 DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(BUS_DT_K) as max_dt FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D
)
SELECT 
    c.LGL_NM as borrower_name, 
    r.DSPLY_NM as esg_rating, 
    r.DSC as rating_description
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON f.BUS_DT_K = ls.max_dt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CR_RTG r ON f.CR_RTG_K = r.CR_RTG_K AND r.IS_CURR = TRUE
WHERE f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL AND f.CR_RTG_K IS NOT NULL

WITH scores AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTRING(STSFC_SCR_VAL1 FROM 'value ([0-9]+)') AS INTEGER) as score
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT 
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_CMPLT.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K 
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 
      AND STSFC_SCR_VAL1 LIKE '%value %'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score >= 9) as promoters,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score <= 6) as detractors
    FROM scores
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ((promoters::float - detractors::float) / total::float) * 100 
    END as nps
FROM metrics;
SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = TRUE) as weekend_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = FALSE) as weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH balances AS (
    SELECT 
        a.ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' THEN a.RPRTN_BAL_AMT END) as bal_june,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31' THEN a.RPRTN_BAL_AMT END) as bal_dec
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN ('2025-06-30', '2025-12-31')
    GROUP BY a.ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM balances 
WHERE bal_june IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec < bal_june * 0.9

SELECT 
    cat.DSPLY_NM as category_name,
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))) as avg_days_to_resolve
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT) = 2025
  AND f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND cat.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM;

WITH customer_versions AS (
    SELECT 
        BUS_ID, 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        VRSN_NBR, 
        IS_CURR,
        LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) as prev_segment
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM customer_versions 
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE 
  AND prev_segment IS NOT NULL 
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev_segment;

WITH quarterly_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        d.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.BUS_ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dt.QTR_NBR) = 4
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM quarterly_customers;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2
      ON w.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c2
      ON w.CUST_K = c2.CUST_K
    WHERE
      d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c2.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
  );

WITH snap_2024 AS (
    SELECT LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30')
      AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
),
snap_2025 AS (
    SELECT LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
      AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as loan_count
FROM snap_2024 s24
JOIN snap_2025 s25 ON s24.LN_ID = s25.LN_ID;

WITH sorted_transfers AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CCY_CD1, 
        f.ORGNL_AMT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) as row_asc,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.CCY_CD1) as total_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT 
    CCY_CD1,
    AVG(ORGNL_AMT) as median_amount
FROM sorted_transfers
WHERE row_asc IN ((total_count + 1) / 2, (total_count + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.CAL_YR_NBR as yr, 
        COUNT(*) as txn_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
    WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
),
growth AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN txn_cnt END) as cnt_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN txn_cnt END) as cnt_2025
    FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(((cnt_2025 - cnt_2024) * 100.0 / cnt_2024), 2) as percentage_growth
FROM growth;

WITH MonthEndDates AS (
    SELECT 
        d.MTH_NBR, 
        MAX(d.DT_K) as last_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT 
    med.MTH_NBR, 
    SUM(f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT) as total_closing_balance
FROM MonthEndDates med
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON med.last_dt_k = f.BUS_DT_K
GROUP BY med.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY med.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE
  c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT <= '2025-12-31'
  AND (
    (t.PSTD_AT >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND t.PSTD_AT < '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    OR (t.INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND t.INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
  )

SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' >= EFF_FRM_DT 
  AND ('2023-06-30' < EFF_TO_DT OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH CustTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        C.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        C.BUS_ID, 
        SUM(F.STLM_AMT) as total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF F
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST C ON F.CUST_K = C.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
    WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND C.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
RankedCust AS (
    SELECT 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        BUS_ID, 
        total_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rank
    FROM CustTotals
)
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
    BUS_ID, 
    total_amount
FROM RankedCust
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1, total_amount DESC;

WITH total_2025 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
ccy_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CCY_CD1, 
        COUNT(*) as ccy_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY CCY_CD1
)
SELECT 
    ccy_counts.CCY_CD1,
    (ccy_counts.ccy_count * 100.0 / total_2025.total_count) as share_percentage
FROM ccy_counts, total_2025;

SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR, 
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS monthly_count,
    SUM(COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN f.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE f.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT 
        END
    ) as total_eur_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON f.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K 
    AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' 
    AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM INTTD_AT) as month_number,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) as decline_share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    c.dsply_nm AS channel, 
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_chnl c ON f.chnl_k = c.chnl_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY c.dsply_nm
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM as jurisdiction, 
    COUNT(f.ALRT_ID) as alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.DTCTN_AT) = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT 
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, 
    COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  count(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH LastDate AS (
    SELECT MAX(DT_K) as end_of_month_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND MTH_NBR = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
JOIN LastDate ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.end_of_month_k
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ctg.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, 
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS average_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name, 
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND m.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT 
    ACCT_TYP_CD1, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) as num_accounts
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT 
    br.CTY_NM as city, 
    COUNT(txn.ATM_TXN_F_K) as atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE txn.INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND txn.INTTD_AT < '2025-04-01'
  AND br.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  AVG(f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) 
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD' 
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR, 
    COUNT(*) as dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE
  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c_txn ON t.CUST_K = c_txn.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
      c_txn.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )

SELECT 
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND ctg.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT 
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, 
    SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT 
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' 
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM, 
    COUNT(*) as alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND f.DTCTN_AT >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND f.DTCTN_AT < '2026-01-01'
  AND j.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
  count(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, 
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT 
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name, 
    SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE f.BUS_DT_K = 20251231
  AND p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) as sme_cross_border_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        br.RGN_CD1, 
        br.DSPLY_NM, 
        COUNT(*) as txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND br.IS_CURR = true
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM, txn_count
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT 
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) as total_amt 
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
WHERE f.ATHRZ_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND f.ATHRZ_AT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amt DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    c.BUS_ID, 
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) as total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  ON c.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.BUS_ID IN (
    SELECT
      c2.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c2
    JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
      ON c2.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
    WHERE
      d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_transfers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01'

SELECT 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, 
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

-- No explicit ESG rating column found in the explored tables. 
-- This query attempts to join customers with their current credit ratings, 
-- assuming 'corporate' is a segment and ESG might be part of the rating description or code.
SELECT 
    c.lgl_nm, 
    r.dsply_nm as rating_name, 
    r.dsc as rating_description
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CR_RTG r ON c.bus_id = r.bus_id
WHERE c.is_curr = TRUE 
  AND r.is_curr = TRUE 
  AND (c.cust_sgmnt_cd1 = 'CORPORATE' OR c.cust_clssf_cd1 = 'CORPORATE')
  AND (r.dsc ILIKE '%ESG%' OR r.bus_cd1 ILIKE '%ESG%')
SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = TRUE THEN 1 END) as weekend_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = FALSE THEN 1 END) as weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BUS_DT_K = 20250630 THEN RPRTN_BAL_AMT END) as bal_jun,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BUS_DT_K = 20251231 THEN RPRTN_BAL_AMT END) as bal_dec
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (20250630, 20251231)
    GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) 
FROM balances 
WHERE bal_jun IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec < (bal_jun * 0.9)

SELECT 
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS category_name, 
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))) AS avg_resolution_days
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE 
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT < '2026-01-01'
  AND ctg.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

WITH customer_versions AS (
    SELECT 
        BUS_ID, 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        VRSN_NBR, 
        IS_CURR,
        LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) as prev_segment
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM customer_versions 
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE 
  AND prev_segment IS NOT NULL 
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev_segment;

WITH customer_quarters AS (
    SELECT 
        c.BUS_ID,
        d.QTR_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY c.BUS_ID, d.QTR_NBR
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as distinct_customers
FROM (
    SELECT BUS_ID
    FROM customer_quarters
    GROUP BY BUS_ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) as final_list

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    ON d.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
        JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_w
            ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt_w.DT_K
        JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c_w
            ON w.CUST_K = c_w.CUST_K
        WHERE
            dt_w.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
            AND c_w.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
    )

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t2024.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D t2024
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2024 ON t2024.BUS_DT_K = d2024.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D t2025 ON t2024.LN_ID = t2025.LN_ID
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2025 ON t2025.BUS_DT_K = d2025.DT_K
WHERE d2024.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
  AND t2024.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND d2025.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  AND t2025.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.CAL_YR_NBR, 
        COUNT(*) as txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
    WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT 
    (MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_count END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count END)) * 100.0 / 
     NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count END), 0) as growth_pct
FROM yearly_counts;

WITH MonthlyLastDates AS (
    SELECT 
        MTH_NBR, 
        MAX(CAL_DT) as last_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY MTH_NBR
),
LastDateKeys AS (
    SELECT 
        mld.MTH_NBR, 
        d.DT_K
    FROM MonthlyLastDates mld
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON mld.last_dt = d.CAL_DT
)
SELECT 
    ldk.MTH_NBR, 
    SUM(f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT) as total_closing_balance
FROM LastDateKeys ldk
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON ldk.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
GROUP BY ldk.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY ldk.MTH_NBR;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.CUST_SNC_DT) = 2025
  AND (
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.PSTD_AT) = 2025 
    OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.INTTD_AT) = 2025
  );

SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' >= EFF_FRM_DT 
  AND ('2023-06-30' < EFF_TO_DT OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        C.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        C.BUS_ID,
        SUM(F.STLM_AMT) as total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF F
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST C ON F.CUST_K = C.CUST_K
    WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND C.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY C.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, C.BUS_ID
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        BUS_ID,
        total_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rank
    FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 as segment_code,
    BUS_ID as customer_id,
    total_amount
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1, total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) AS percentage_share
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1

SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR, 
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS monthly_count,
    SUM(COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

WITH transfers AS (
    SELECT 
        f.ORGNL_AMT,
        f.CCY_CD1,
        f.BUS_DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
rates AS (
    SELECT 
        BUS_DT_K,
        QUOT_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
    WHERE BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
)
SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT 
            ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / r.MID_RT 
        END
    ) AS total_amount_eur
FROM transfers t
LEFT JOIN rates r ON t.BUS_DT_K = r.BUS_DT_K AND t.CCY_CD1 = r.currency_code;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM INTTD_AT) as month_number,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as declined_share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume 
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K 
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
